node_1.subject: John Lin
node_1.description: This is John Lin's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 13:00 am, , Have breakfast and prepare for the day from **7:00 am to 8:30 am**, Walk to the Willow Market and Pharmacy to open the pharmacy counter at **9:00 am**, , Close the pharmacy counter and return home at **5:00 pm**, , Discuss the upcoming local mayor election with his family and ask if they have heard any candidates' names from **6:30 pm to 7:30 pm**, Watch the local evening news to catch any election announcements from **7:30 pm to 8:30 pm**.
